idea-plugin.name: WinPortKill
idea-plugin.description:
Inspect local Windows x64 listening ports and processes directly inside JetBrains IDEs.

  • Ports and processes views in a Tool Window
  • Filter by PID, process name, protocol, address, or port
  • Kill the selected process from the IDE
  • Local sidecar backend shared with the Rust CLI toolset
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0

  • Initial public release
  • Ports and processes inspection views
  • Filter and kill actions
  • Windows x64 sidecar integration
